title: A specified sheaf pairing determines cancellation in the explicit site tensor
statement: Let C be a category with Grothendieck topology J, essentially small in the chosen coefficient universe, with additive sheafification, W equal to the locally bijective maps, and the ring-valued sheaf composition functor. Let R be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use the module category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], ordinary sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and its pure sections [lem-pur-sheaf-line-evaluation-inverse-pair]. For any R-module sheaves P,Q and any specified isomorphism e:P tensor Q ≅ R, there exists exactly one natural isomorphism between successive explicit site tensor by P and by Q and the identity functor whose value on (x tensor p) tensor q is e(p tensor q) times x. No local freeness assumption or choice of a pairing is added.

proof.text: The ordinary tensor comparison identifies each explicit site tensor with monoidal sheaf tensor, naturally in the variable module; its pure-section formula and pure tensor extensionality prove the required naturality.

proof.text: Transport monoidal reassociation followed by e and the right unitor through these comparisons. The pure formulas for the comparison, reassociation and unitor give e(p tensor q) times x on nested site tensors.

proof.text: Two cancellation natural isomorphisms with this formula have equal hom components by the trilinear universal property; extensionality for natural transformations and isomorphisms proves uniqueness. This includes the zero ring and zero sheaves whenever the specified e exists.

lean.statement:
theorem siteTensorCancellation (P Q : LineEvaluation.Modules.{uC, vC, r} R)
    (e : P ⊗ Q ≅ unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) :
    ∃! c : siteSheafTensorRight P ⋙ siteSheafTensorRight Q ≅ 𝟭 _,
      ∀ (M : LineEvaluation.Modules.{uC, vC, r} R) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
        (x : M.val.obj U) (p : P.val.obj U) (q : Q.val.obj U),
        (c.hom.app M).val.app U
          (siteSheafTensorTmul _ Q U (siteSheafTensorTmul M P U x p) q) =
          @SMul.smul _ _ (M.val.obj U).isModule.toSMul
            (e.hom.val.app U (LineEvaluation.pureTensor R P Q U p q)) x
